capture_contract.note: Kraken and OKX were opened as direct public ticker API responses. OKX exposes a ticker snapshot timestamp; Kraken does not. Other sources have their own publication, display or snapshot times. No common synchronized cutoff or byte-complete wire receipt is claimed.

limitations: No provider event timestamp is exposed.
The returned ticker is rendered JSON, not original HTTP wire bytes or headers.
Last trade 1.18304 is below the displayed best bid 1.18308, so trade/book fields are not assumed synchronous.
The ts field is the ticker snapshot timestamp, not a separately supplied last-trade event timestamp.
XRP-USDT is not XRP-USD; no FX normalization or executable cross-venue comparison is performed.
Rendered response is not original HTTP wire bytes or headers.

kraken.interpretation: The trade and book fields may be asynchronous; do not infer a crossed book or executable price from this ticker rendering.

okx.interpretation: The ts field is a ticker snapshot time, not a separately supplied last-trade event time.

spot.reason: Kraken XRP/USD and OKX XRP/USDT are asynchronous, have different quote currencies and expose different rolling/day windows. No USD/USDT normalization, common cutoff or executable arbitrage claim is made.

fuelmaps.scope: Hourly aggregation of one-minute spot-book snapshots; resting visible orders only.

edgeornot.scope: 15-minute averaged Binance spot plus OKX perpetual; not spot-only and not comparable with Fuelmaps.

depth.aggregation_rule: Do not add or average Fuelmaps and EdgeOrNot depth. Their venue/instrument universes differ; displayed orders may be canceled and hidden/iceberg liquidity is omitted.

okx_secondary_analysis.scope: OKX-only article-derived series; different timestamps and coverage from TradRadar.

derivatives.interpretation: Both observations show long-heavy account positioning and falling OI over their respective windows. Account counts are not notional exposure; OI in USD can decline with price; liquidation data are incomplete and source-scoped.

xrp_insights_holdings_delta.method: Day-over-day issuer-reported holdings changes; flow-excluded rows count as zero; latest day may be provisional or re-settled.

etf.reason: SoSoValue dollar net-flow status and XRP Insights XRP-quantity holdings deltas use different products, universes and methods. Do not average or relabel the holdings delta as AP cash creation/redemption.

reconciliation.interpretation: Reserve series, wallet-label universes, time windows and large-transfer filters differ. The reported +280M reserve change is not proof of open-market purchases; transaction shares are not quantities; internal transfers and wallet relabeling can change aggregates.

macro.context: The prior-session equity sell-off and the post-release Nov 6 cross-asset rebound are different event windows. Neither establishes an XRP-specific causal effect.

hypotheses.claim: The Nov 5 broad risk-off session was a major contributor to XRP weakness.
support: CryptoTicker reports broad equity/crypto weakness and XRP underperformance versus BTC in its early-Nov-6 snapshot.
counter: Reuters reports Nasdaq and S&P gains after the Nov 6 jobs release, while the later direct XRP snapshots remain weak; windows are asynchronous and no causal estimate exists.

hypotheses.claim: Long-heavy derivatives positioning and liquidations amplified the move.
support: TradRadar reports $11.36M long liquidations versus $0.60034M short liquidations and a 3.90 account ratio.
CryptoTicker's OKX-only observations show account ratios near 4 and declining OI.
counter: Account counts are not notional exposure; funding is small and positive; OI in USD is price-sensitive; venue coverage differs.

hypotheses.claim: The reported Binance reserve increase reflects post-incident replenishment or wallet movement rather than necessarily new spot demand.
support: CryptoBasic reports a 280M XRP reserve increase after the October 29 incident and Binance had stated customer backing was restored.
counter: CryptoBasic says the origin is unconfirmed; XRP Insights reports a different 2.74B Binance balance; TrackWhale's filtered seven-day large-transfer series is net outflow.

hypotheses.claim: The lack of recent net ETF inflows reduced marginal spot demand.
support: TokenPost/SoSoValue reports three consecutive no-flow trading days through Nov 5.
counter: Cumulative net inflows remain $1.81B; XRP Insights reports a -149,487 XRP holdings delta over a different four-day window; neither gives complete AP cash files.

hypotheses.claim: Displayed bid-heavy spot depth may have absorbed part of the sell flow.
support: Fuelmaps' 18:00 six-venue snapshot shows 60.09%-67.78% bid share across its displayed bands.
counter: Snapshot is 93.75 minutes old at capture; Binance and Bitget are excluded; orders are cancellable; EdgeOrNot mixes spot and perpetual books.

hypotheses.claim: The repeatedly observed $1.19 area may be a technical reference but not a structural floor.
support: CryptoTicker describes three tests around $1.19/$1.20 and a Friday-morning low of $1.188.
counter: Current Kraken and OKX snapshots are around $1.183; levels are secondary chart analysis, not a causal or guaranteed support mechanism.

reasons: No synchronized common cutoff across spot, depth, derivatives, ETF, exchange-flow and macro sources.
Kraken lacks a provider timestamp; OKX timestamp is a ticker snapshot, not last-trade event time.
USD and USDT instruments are not normalized or treated as executable cross-venue prices.
Depth sources use different venue/instrument universes; the spot-only snapshot is stale and cancellable.
Derivatives aggregates have different venue coverage, update delays and units.
ETF sources report different measures and product universes.
Binance reserve increase is secondary reporting with unknown wallet origin; XRP Insights and TrackWhale series disagree in scope and direction.
No leakage-safe out-of-sample predictive lift or calibrated probability evidence is established.
